description.value:
Compatibility: Bestial

Wild-Blood minotaurs share a kinship with the more primeval and remote stretches of the wilderness. They sport shorter horns and longer fur than most of their kin, sometimes with especially deep hunching, giving off a more ragged or natural look.

The wild-blood’s tie to the natural energies of the world is rather unique, often seen with a lesser natural spirit in animal form at their side. While wild-bloods are able to conjure various animal forms, it is said that wild-bloods are soul-bound to the first spirit they ever conjure. This ‘spirit guide’ is said to look over them through life and beyond from birth, and the summoning is just giving them a form. In fact, this initial animal form is said to become the easiest for the wild-blood to conjure from then on. Forming any other shape is thought to only re-shape their spirit guardian rather than call another. The cause of this connection is unknown, but being that wild-blood is generally hereditary unlike other minotaur branches, it’s thought that these ‘spirit guides’ may be the result of a bloodline blessing or are ancestral spirits looking after their kin.

Some wild-bloods also swear that they can understand their familiar, advising them either literally or indirectly. Perhaps a voice in the wind on their familiar’s fur, or a tilt of the head that carries more meaning than it should, or even literal speech. In any case, it’s often a source of reassurance and comfort for a wild-blood. It’s for this reason that wild-bloods are thought to be wiser and more self-assured than their kin. Some wild-bloods are said to use their spirit guide’s reassurances as an echo chamber that leads them to overconfidence and recklessness, others can’t interpret their spirit at all, relying on their own instincts instead.

Regardless of the origin, wild-blood minotaur are most often connected and drawn to lush environments; forests, jungles, lakes, and marshes, for example.

Wild-Blood Minotaur Traits

  • Attribute Increase: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.
  • Spirit Guide: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.RZSLDAG5NL15FBEM]{Spirit Guide}
  • Spirit Guidance: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.1THSTBQHCP5YUGKL]{Spirit Guidance}

Alternate Heritage: Minotaur heritage can be present in various ways. If your core race does not already grant you Horns, you can choose to replace either the “Spirit Guidance” racial trait with the @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.HF5TGW1UQJY6J1GK]{Lesser Horns} alternate heritage trait from the start of this section.
